spec.description: Fleet inventory: models, providers, SNMP groups, serials, and firmware when profiles export it. Companion to Device Summary — drill to Device Details.

spec.title: Devices
spec.description: Unique devices reporting SNMP polling health.

spec.title: Distinct models
spec.description: Distinct tags_kentik_model values across reporting devices.

spec.title: Devices Δ 24h
spec.description: Change in reporting device count vs 24h ago.

spec.expr: (count(count by(device_name) (kentik_snmp_PollingHealth{tags_snmp_group=~"$snmp_group",provider=~"$provider",device_name=~"$device_name"})) OR vector(0)) - (count(count by(device_name) (kentik_snmp_PollingHealth{tags_snmp_group=~"$snmp_group",provider=~"$provider",device_name=~"$device_name"} offset 24h)) OR vector(0))

spec.title: Device inventory
spec.description: One row per device from kentik_snmp_CPU labels. Click through to Device Details.

spec.title: Polling health
spec.description: 1 = Healthy. Non-1 means the poller is struggling for that device.

spec.title: Hardware serials (chassis / FRU)
spec.description: Nokia TIMETRA hw_serial tags (and similar when present). Lab simulators often show placeholder serials.

spec.title: Firmware / software versions
spec.description: Portable probe for firmware/software/sysDescr-style metrics from snmp-profiles. Empty on estates that only export model tags (e.g. current SRL lab) — use Devices + model instead.

spec.expr: count by(device_name, tags_kentik_model) ({__name__=~"(?i)kentik_snmp_.*(firmware|software.?version|sysDescr|sysdescr).*",tags_snmp_group=~"$snmp_group",provider=~"$provider",device_name=~"$device_name"}) OR on() vector(0)

spec.title: Firmware series present
spec.description: Non-zero when firmware-like series exist for the current filters.

spec.title: 05. Network Inventory
